name: Hypercubes and Two-Dimensional Partial Cubes Are Incomparable
scope: Finite classes and finite partial cubes under the survey dictionary.
statement: Neither the class of hypercubes nor the class of two-dimensional partial cubes contains the other.
proof: The hypercube $Q_3$ has VC dimension three and is not two-dimensional. The six-cycle has VC dimension two but is not a hypercube.
